composition.title: Market Loop
composition.key: Bb dorian, modal shift to Bb mixolydian in C

A (1-8): Bbm11 | Bbm11 | Ab | Ab, twice (quartal organ Eb-Ab-Db / Eb-Ab-C)
C (25-32): Ab, chromatic A pickup into Bbm11

form: A, bars 1-8: long open vamp - two band-passed pulse guitar riffs interlock note-for-gap (left on the downbeat side, right in the gaps), shekere sixteenths with the scrape on every and, a seven-stroke iron bell pattern, the bass ostinato and quartal organ chops; the horns enter at bar 5 with a short F-Ab-Bb call in parallel fourths; snare fill in bar 8.

B, bars 9-16: the guitars switch to a second interlock, the bass jumps octaves, the organ holds breathing chords, and the horns state the theme in parallel fourths: Bb-Ab-F rising to Db6, answered down to Eb, then a second phrase reaching Eb6.
A', bars 17-24: the first interlock returns with an upper-neighbour (Eb-Db) variation in bars 21-22, organ chops busier, horns only answer at phrase ends (bars 18, 20, 22, 24).

C, bars 25-32: modal shift to Bb mixolydian - Bb7 | Bb7 | Ab | Ab twice, D natural in guitar 1, guitar 2, organ and the horn line, horns now in octaves; a snare fill and chromatic A in bass and horns lead back to Bbm11.
composition.motif: A horn theme that hammers Bb, steps down to Ab-F and springs back up to Db6, voiced in parallel fourths (second horn a perfect fourth below), later in octaves.
composition.intent: Afro-funk: interlocking repeating guitar-like riffs (two short band-passed pulse figures exactly offset, panned left and right), shekere-like soft-attack noise sixteenths with accented ands, a constant iron-bell pattern, a propulsive square bass ostinato, kick on one, and of two and and of three (not four on the floor), a light snare with ghost strokes and rolling fills, square organ chords in quartal voicings with tremolo, and a horn section melody in parallel fourths (A-A') and octaves (C). A long open minor vamp in Bb dorian that shifts mode to Bb mixolydian in C. Hypnotic, polyrhythmic and sunny, straight sixteenths.

suggestedUses: trading and crafting in the base
